from ledgerly.adjustments import write_off

def test_write_off():

    result = write_off(inv, datetime(2026, 2, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc), "customer insolvent")
    assert inv.status == "void" and result["amount"] == Decimal("50.00")
from datetime import datetime

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Invoice, Payment
from .money import ZERO, round_money


def authorize(payment_id: str, invoice: Invoice, amount, at: datetime) -> Payment:
    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if invoice.status != "issued":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}")
    payment = Payment(id=payment_id, invoice_id=invoice.id, amount=amount, created_at=ensure_utc(at))
    audit.record("payment_authorized", payment_id=payment.id, amount=amount)
    return payment
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal


@dataclass
class LineItem:
    description: str
    quantity: int
    unit_price: Decimal


@dataclass
class Invoice:
    id: str
    customer_id: str
    currency: str = "USD"
    lines: list[LineItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    issued_at: datetime | None = None
    status: str = "draft"  # draft | issued | paid | void


@dataclass
class Payment:
    id: str
    invoice_id: str
    amount: Decimal
    status: str = "authorized"  # authorized | captured | voided | refunded
    created_at: datetime | None = None
    captured_at: datetime | None = None
    refunded_amount: Decimal = Decimal("0.00")


@dataclass
class Subscription:
    id: str
    customer_id: str
    plan_price: Decimal
    period_days: int
    started_at: datetime
    canceled_at: datetime | None = None
